The '''Pathandr system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the conflict known as the [[Pathandr Fury]], which involved the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] and was fought in [[5451 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Pathandr [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square O-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
